notes: Tech stack: Unified Express 4.21.2 gateway (server.ts:214) serving React 19 + Vite 8.3 SPA (Nemofy Agent/) and supervising a pure-Python FastAPI + LangGraph + aiosqlite Agent-Core backend (Agent-Core/agent_core/api.py:219, server/agentProcessManager.ts:186) on 127.0.0.1:8100.

Auth & Session boundary: Express uses HMAC-SHA256 tokens in HttpOnly cookie or Authorization Bearer header verified by AuthStore (server.ts:90-162, server/authStore.ts:121-167). Default password falls back to hardcoded string when NEMOFY_ADMIN_PASSWORD is unset (server/authStore.ts:22). Standalone static frontend mode embeds SHA-256 digest of default credentials client-side (Nemofy Agent/src/lib/authValidation.ts:3-4, apiClient.ts:212-218).

CSRF & CORS boundaries: Express gates cookie mutations via isSameOriginMutation (server.ts:131-147), permitting requests with no Origin header or any X-Requested-With header. FastAPI enables CORSMiddleware with allow_origins=["*"] and allow_credentials=True by default (Agent-Core/agent_core/api.py:316-327) and enforces AGENT_API_TOKEN via require_auth (api.py:329-354).

Secrets & Vault boundary: Per-user provider API keys are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM + scrypt in data/vaults/<user>.vault.json (server/profileVault.ts:87-222) and pushed to Python FastAPI /config/secrets (server.ts:67-75), which writes them into process-global os.environ (Agent-Core/agent_core/api.py:373-383).

Filesystem & Media boundaries: /api/filesystem/* and /api/media/* confine access to workspace/ and data/uploads/ via path.resolve prefix checks (server/configStore.ts:426-538). Agent-Core sandbox resolves /workspace paths with symlink checks (Agent-Core/agent_core/sandbox.py:137-196) and runs commands via Docker or local_isolated bash subprocesses (sandbox.py:471-570).

Outbound HTTP / SSRF boundaries: Express /api/settings/models and /api/settings/probe fetch caller-supplied base_url directly without private/loopback IP restrictions (server.ts:1252-1300, server/providerCatalog.ts:277-560). Python web_fetch checks hostname string/literal IP before redirects (Agent-Core/agent_core/tools/local.py:58-105), while MCP servers connect to user-configured URLs (MCPs/manager.py:68-114).

State & Concurrency boundaries: Express stores threads in flat JSON data/threads.json via read-modify-write without file locking (server/configStore.ts:1036-1048, server.ts:462-596, 821-876) and tracks live jobs in an in-memory Map activeChatJobs (server.ts:601). Python JobManager runs async tasks with a stall watchdog and ContextVars per request (Agent-Core/agent_core/jobs.py:239-440, graph.py:100-126).
